name: barcode-label-maker
description: Turn a product sheet into barcode labels: EAN-13 and UPC-A with check-digit verification, Code 128 for SKUs and anything else, with product name and price, laid out on common A4/Letter label sheets (3×8, 4×10, 2×7, 5×13, 3×10). Set copies per product, skip labels already used on a sheet, fix codes in the panel and export a print-ready PDF plus SVG barcodes. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a product sheet into barcode labels: EAN-13 and UPC-A with check-digit verification, Code 128 for SKUs and anything else, with product name and price, laid out on common A4/Letter label sheets (3×8, 4×10, 2×7, 5×13, 3×10). Set copies per product, skip labels already used on a sheet, fix codes in the panel and export a print-ready PDF plus SVG barcodes. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把商品表做成条码标签：EAN-13、UPC-A 自动核对校验位，货号等其他内容用 Code 128，可带品名和价格，按常见 A4/Letter 不干胶标签纸（3×8、4×10、2×7、5×13、3×10）排版。可设每个商品打印几张、跳过半张纸上已用的标签，在面板里修正条码，导出可直接打印的 PDF 和 SVG 条码。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
